original_question: Several specific open problems that exist in this context are mentioned in~. More generally, try to extend the approach in~ to other types of PDEs or preconditioners.
target_in_paper: Section 2.5, Problem 2.11. The draft is aiming at the official open problem that asks to extend the [GNS22, NS24] eigenvalue-localization approach beyond the elliptic-PDE/Laplacian-preconditioning setting; the immediately preceding §2.5 context explains that, for certain elliptic PDE model problems such as −∇·(k(x)∇u)=f and the associated linear systems, that approach gives exact localization of the eigenvalues of the discretized operator and of the left-preconditioned matrix under Laplacian preconditioning. missing_details: The blank citation placeholders need to be resolved. In the paper, the approach being extended is explicitly attributed to [GNS22, NS24], while the contextual remark about already-listed specific open problems points to [GHW24, Section 4]. The draft does not say what the approach actually does. The nearby §2.5 context says that for certain elliptic PDE model problems, e.g. −∇·(k(x)∇u)=f, and the associated linear algebraic systems, one can obtain exact localization of the eigenvalues of the discretized operators and of the left-preconditioned matrices under Laplacian preconditioning. ([znakschoola.ru](https://www.znakschoola.ru/?_=%2Fpdf%2F2602.05394%23UE7DkG0PaBHZOakR54g1Wl8%3D&utm_source=openai))

The official problem is specifically about extending that approach to other types of PDEs or to other preconditioners; it is not one of the neighboring GMRES/nonnormality problems in the same subsection. ([znakschoola.ru](https://www.znakschoola.ru/?_=%2Fpdf%2F2602.05394%23UE7DkG0PaBHZOakR54g1Wl8%3D&utm_source=openai))

The first sentence of the draft is contextual rather than stand-alone. A paper-faithful rewrite should replace the vague phrase 'in this context' by the actual context from §2.5: eigenvalue localization for discretizations of certain elliptic PDE model problems and their Laplacian-left-preconditioned systems. A faithful stand-alone question should therefore not invent any such assumptions. ([znakschoola.ru](https://www.znakschoola.ru/?_=%2Fpdf%2F2602.05394%23UE7DkG0PaBHZOakR54g1Wl8%3D&utm_source=openai))

refined_question: Can the eigenvalue-localization approach of [GNS22, NS24]—which, for certain elliptic PDE model problems such as −∇·(k(x)∇u)=f and the associated discretized linear systems, yields exact localization of the eigenvalues of the discretized operator and of the left-preconditioned matrix under Laplacian preconditioning—be extended to other classes of PDEs or to other preconditioners? ([znakschoola.ru](https://www.znakschoola.ru/?_=%2Fpdf%2F2602.05394%23UE7DkG0PaBHZOakR54g1Wl8%3D&utm_source=openai))
justification: Your draft matches the §2.5 lead-in paragraph and the official Problem 2.11 almost verbatim at the level of intent: it refers to specific open problems already noted elsewhere in this area, then asks for a broader extension of the [GNS22, NS24] approach. The neighboring official problems in the same subsection (Problems 2.12–2.14) are about GMRES, nonnormality, and transient convergence behavior, not about extending a PDE/preconditioner eigenvalue-localization framework, so Problem 2.11 is the uniquely correct target. The instruction block mentioning Conjecture 1.1, Proposition 1.2, and Theorem 1.3 is not applicable here, because this paper is a workshop open-problems survey and the draft clearly points to §2.5 instead. ([znakschoola.ru](https://www.znakschoola.ru/?_=%2Fpdf%2F2602.05394%23UE7DkG0PaBHZOakR54g1Wl8%3D&utm_source=openai))
